title: Week Ahead — Market Outlook
headline: Markets head into a catalyst-dense week where Fed messaging, Q2 GDP/PCE, and mega-cap earnings could amplify single-day moves and cross-asset volatility.
volatilityRationale: Catalysts are stacked mid-week (Fed decision plus several mega-cap prints) and then compound into the GDP/PCE data window, a setup that can reprice rates and equity risk premia quickly if surprises cluster.

recap.text: Investors headed into the new week after a risk-off stretch with geopolitical risk and oil price sensitivity discussed as key overhangs in market commentary.
Volatility had moved higher recently in public market data feeds, highlighting a more cautious regime versus earlier summer conditions.
Market participants faced shifting expectations around the upcoming Fed decision, with commentary emphasizing how policy guidance and inflation dynamics could drive repricing.

triggers.text: FOMC rate decision and press conference (policy guidance and risk of hawkish surprise).
Q2 U.S. GDP and June PCE inflation prints (rates and 'soft landing' narrative sensitivity).
Mega-cap earnings cluster (Microsoft, Meta, Amazon, Apple) with AI/data-center capex read-through for indexes and semis.
Options positioning/expiration mechanics (weekly expirations and monthlies can concentrate hedging flows).

watch.text: Whether volatility stays bid or mean-reverts after the Fed; watch for outsized index moves around the decision and subsequent GDP/PCE releases.
Earnings 'quality' signals beyond headlines: guidance tone, buyback commentary, and capex intensity, especially in mega-cap tech.
